rendered:
According to the document "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials" (cssc-2020), the PVDF binder was not removed or dissolved during the EG-based separation process. This was confirmed by FTIR and EDX spectra. 

Table 1 from the document shows the Hansen solubility parameters of PVDF, NMP, DMF, EG, and HSP distance of PVDF-solvent. The HSP distance for EG is 16.9 (MPa)^1/2, which is much higher than that of NMP and DMF. This indicates that EG has a lower ability to dissolve PVDF compared to NMP and DMF. 

The authors also mentioned that the Hansen solubility parameters analysis is in good agreement with the experimental results from FTIR and EDX spectra, which confirmed that the PVDF binder was not dissolved during the EG-based separation process.
